title: Studio Notification v1
description: A conceptual transient-notification shape. PLANNED — no toast/snackbar component exists in the running application; feedback today is always inline (a banner, a badge, a disabled button with a title). See docs/bible/11-studio/267-status-and-feedback-system.md. This schema documents the target shape a future implementation could adopt, grounded in the severity vocabulary that already exists (ValidationResult.severity).

level.description: INFO maps to the existing 'information' ValidationResult severity; WARNING/ERROR map to 'warning'/'error'. SUCCESS has no existing backend equivalent — it would be a purely frontend-originated notification (e.g. 'Export complete').

relatedParameter.description: Mirrors ValidationResult.parameter when the notification originates from a validation diagnostic.
